next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.5.6 SR2: in the Report Section LINE-COUNTER only in a SOURCE clause; in the Procedure Division in any integral-value context; 'only the report writer control system can change the content of LINE-COUNTER'. §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR1 states the first two parts ('may be referenced only in a SOURCE clause' / 'in any context where an integer data item may appear') and §2023:8.4.3.15.3 SR3 the third ('LINE-COUNTER shall not be referenced as a receiving operand'). Same requirement, compile-time in both.
